coverage.summary: Rent-controlled units under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance. Units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the increase limits, as are Costa-Hawkins-eligible tenancies and some agency-regulated tenancies.

result.notes: D079 says units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the rent increase limits. Covered units are therefore those with a Certificate of Occupancy on or before 1979-06-13. Two values were removed because no document supports them: other_conditions (the Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12 comparison and the claim that the local cap is below the state formula) and supersedes_state_rule=true. They are now null. All other coverage values are unchanged and are backed by verbatim passages from D079 and D080.
